meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简报，按步骤加工成产品发布或宣传视频：抓取素材、生成品牌设计、编写故事板与脚本、逐帧制作并最终渲染出 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当用户想宣传、发布或推广某个产品时触发；粘贴商业网址也适用，网站导览/展示类请求同样归此技能。意图不明时交 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这个 SaaS 产品做个发布宣传视频，网址是 example.com
say.note: 技能会抓取该网址并开始制作流程。

say.text: 按这份产品简报，做一支 30 秒推广视频
say.note: 技能会读取简报并生成故事板与视频。

say.text: 做一支我们官网的导览视频，展示页面布局
say.note: 技能会用抓取的网页截图作为画面素材。

howto.what_en: Turns a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: captures assets, builds a brand design system, writes storyboard & script, generates HTML frames, and renders a final mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tour/showcase requests route here too. Unclear intent → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a launch promo video for our SaaS product at example.com
say_en.note: Kicks off capture from the URL and the video pipeline.

say_en.text: Turn this product brief into a 30-second promo video
say_en.note: Follows the no-capture path using the brief.

say_en.text: Make a site-tour video showcasing our homepage layout
say_en.note: Uses captured page screenshots as the visuals.
